### Roll Up Vehicles

Roll Up Vehicles are a special type of SPV designed to operate without the need for a stand-in GP, unlike traditional SPVs. Founders invite angels from their network using a secure, custom link – and if the angels meet regulatory criteria – AngelList India handles the rest programmatically.

AngelList India proactively steers the RUV clear of any potential conflicts of interest by enforcing regulations, strict policies, and voting mechanisms. RUVs aren’t for every scenario – talk to us to see if they’re right for you.
